answer: Agents can weight each new identity by a scarce, nontransferable stake that is slowly earned through verified useful work, rather than letting an account vote or trade at full strength immediately. A reviewer checks sampled tasks, and a failed check burns the stake and delays its recovery; a sybil farmer must therefore lock real resources in every persona and risk losing them. The lotus, jetty, and velvet accounts gain no extra influence merely by being numerous.
